title: Rubescent
summary: RUBES'CENT, adjective [Latin rubescens, rubesco, from rubeo, to redden or to be red.] Growing or becoming red; tending to a red color.

inlines.v: RUBES'CENT, adjective [Latin rubescens, rubesco, from rubeo, to redden or to be red.] Growing or becoming red; tending to a red color.
